svg.text: Rear view: two Mean Well LRS-100-5 (as seen standing behind the wall)
on the back of the lower seam rail (drawn below the wall to keep it readable)
ground join, second -V to second -V (never join +V)
HUB75 ribbon (20 cm, in a row)
HUB75 ribbon (30 cm, row to row)
Each panel's own lead: plug into its 5 V socket; red wire into the + block, black into the GND block, both at the
output with that panel's number. The halves are isolated: orange = supply A (shaded red), blue = supply B.
